# Rules

Everything this app's UI must not do, in one place. Read it before writing UI. A rule marked "review" has no script yet, so a reviewer checks it.

| ID | Rule | Answered on | Ground | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rule/arbitrary-value` | A Tailwind arbitrary value such as p-[13px] or bg-[#0f766e]. A transition property list, a CSS-wide keyword, a grid area name and math built only from tokens and env() pass | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/button-destructive-variant` | When the action deletes, voids or cancels, use variant="destructive" instead of palette classes such as className="bg-red-600 text-white", because palette classes skip the --destructive token and its dark-mode value. | [button](/system/button.md) | app | review, plus `rg -n "bg-red-" app components lib` |
| `rule/button-icon-name` | When size is icon, icon-xs, icon-sm or icon-lg, pass an aria-label naming the action and mark the icon aria-hidden instead of leaving the glyph as the only content, because the button then has no accessible name and a screen reader says only "button". | [button](/system/button.md) | app, principle | review, and an a11y scan of the page |
| `rule/button-label-verb-first` | When a Button holds text, write it in sentence case starting with a verb and naming the object, such as "Record payment", instead of Title Case or a bare noun such as "Payment", because the label is the action's accessible name and the app's action labels already read this way. | [button](/system/button.md) | app | review |
| `rule/button-link-render` | When the action navigates to another route, render one element with render={<Link href="/sales/new" />} and nativeButton={false} instead of wrapping a Button in a Link or a Link in a Button, because nested link and button give two tab stops and two roles for one action and are invalid HTML. | [button](/system/button.md) | principle | review |
| `rule/component-override` | A className or style on a component the registry lists that sets padding, radius, shadow or background: Tailwind utilities, inline style keys, or an app-CSS class whose rule sets one. Layout (margin, width, grid or flex placement) passes | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/css-px` | A px, rem or em length for spacing, radius, type or size in a CSS file, outside a custom property line (0 and 1px pass; rem and em pass in line-height, letter-spacing and viewport math; the touch zoom floor font-size: max(16px, 1em) passes) | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/data-table-action-verb` | When a RowAction has a visible label, write a sentence-case verb or verb phrase of 1 to 3 words, such as "Record payment", "Approve" or "View tills", instead of an icon alone, because the label is the button's only name unless ariaLabel is set. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app | review |
| `rule/data-table-empty-compact` | When the table can end up with no rows, pass empty={<EmptyState size="compact" title={...} description={...} />} instead of leaving the fallback "Nothing to show.", because the fallback names neither the filter behind the empty result nor the way out. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app | review |
| `rule/data-table-label-noun` | When setting label, write what the rows are as a sentence-case plural noun phrase, such as "Customers with credit" or "Stock movements", instead of a verb or "Table", because label is the accessible name of the scroll region and the phone list, and the key of the remembered page size. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app | review |
| `rule/data-table-loading-prop` | When the rows come from a query, pass loading={isLoading} and rows={data} to DataTable instead of wrapping it in a spinner or a hand-made Skeleton, because the table keeps its header, draws 6 skeleton rows and holds back the empty slot until the fetch ends (components/app/data-table.tsx:129). | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app | review |
| `rule/data-table-mobile-slots` | When a column must stay visible on phones, give it a mobile slot (title, subtitle, value or meta) instead of leaving it out, because a column with no mobile slot is not drawn below 768px and nothing on screen says it is missing. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | principle | review |
| `rule/data-table-reset-page` | When the rows are filtered on the client, pass the active filters as resetPageKey instead of remounting the table with a key, because resetPageKey returns to page 1 and keeps the sort and selection, while a remount drops both. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app | review |
| `rule/data-table-right-figures` | When a column holds amounts, counts or percentages, set align: "right" on it instead of left-aligning figures, because right-aligned cells get tabular-nums (components/app/data-table.tsx:202), so digits line up down the column and do not jitter on re-sort. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | principle | review |
| `rule/data-table-row-padding` | When a row needs more room or a divider, add padding inside the cells through className or rowClassName instead of a margin between rows, because the rows share divide-y borders and touch, so every pixel between two rows belongs to one of them and opens it. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app, principle | review |
| `rule/data-table-status-cell` | When a column shows a record's state, such as Paid, Overdue or Low, render StatusBadge in the cell instead of coloured text, because the badge carries the state word and its tone from one table, and colour alone does not tell the state. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | principle | review |
| `rule/data-table-whatsapp-contact` | When a row action contacts a customer, render RowAction with a WhatsApp href, external and the label "WhatsApp" instead of a tel: link labelled "Call", because customers are reached by WhatsApp only in this product. | [data-table](/system/data-table.md) | app | review |
| `rule/deprecated-import` | An import of a component the registry says was replaced | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/doubled-utility` | A Tailwind v4 utility that repeats its property word, such as text-text-muted, bg-bg-subtle or border-border-strong. It comes from a --color-<role> token whose role starts with text, bg or border | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/empty-state-action-link` | When passing an action, render a text button with text-sm font-medium text-primary hover:underline instead of a filled primary Button, because the screen's one filled primary action lives in its page header and a second filled green button competes with it. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app, principle | review |
| `rule/empty-state-compact-inside` | When EmptyState sits inside a DataTable empty slot, a drawer panel or a card, set size="compact" instead of the default, because the default's 56px of space above and below suits a whole section and pushes a panel's other content down. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app | review |
| `rule/empty-state-description-why` | When writing description, say in 1 or 2 full sentences why it is empty or what makes rows appear, such as "Purchases recorded against this supplier show up here.", ending with a full stop, instead of repeating the title, because the title already says what is missing and the description is the only place for the reason. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app | review |
| `rule/empty-state-filtered-clear` | When filters or a search caused the empty result, pass an action labelled "Clear filters" that clears them, instead of no action, because the filters often sit above the fold on a phone and the empty slot is where the person is looking. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app | review |
| `rule/empty-state-icon-only` | When adding art, pass one lucide icon through icon instead of an illustration, an emoji or a tinted circle behind the icon, because the component draws the icon at 24px in --muted-foreground and the visual rules keep the brand palette out of state. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app | review |
| `rule/empty-state-title-no` | When writing title, start with "No {records}" and end on "yet", "match" or "to show" for first-run, filtered and plain empty cases, in sentence case with no full stop, instead of "Empty" or "No data", because the title is the one line every call site shows and it names what is missing. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app | review |
| `rule/empty-state-whatsapp-contact` | When an empty state's action reaches a customer, set its href to whatsAppHref(phone) instead of a tel: call link, because customers are contacted by WhatsApp only in this product. | [empty-state](/system/empty-state.md) | app | review |
| `rule/entity-drawer-destructive-overflow` | When a drawer action deletes, voids, cancels or deactivates the record, put it in overflow as an OverflowMenu item with destructive: true instead of in actions, because the actions row holds the frequent task and one slip there would destroy the record. | [entity-drawer](/system/entity-drawer.md) | app | review |
| `rule/entity-drawer-dismissible-dirty` | When the drawer holds typed text that is not saved yet, pass dismissible computed from that state, such as dismissible={!dirty}, instead of the default true, because an Escape or a backdrop click would close the drawer and drop the text. | [entity-drawer](/system/entity-drawer.md) | app | review |
| `rule/entity-drawer-loading-title` | When the record has not loaded, the title reads "Loading {object}…", and when it failed it reads "{Object} unavailable", instead of an empty title or the record id, because the title is the dialog's accessible name and is all a screen reader hears on open. | [entity-drawer](/system/entity-drawer.md) | app | review |
| `rule/entity-drawer-stat-tone-state` | When a stat's value is not in a real state (overdue, out, low, pending), leave tone unset instead of setting tone: 'good' to make a figure stand out, because status colour is kept for state and one green accent. | [entity-drawer](/system/entity-drawer.md) | app | review |
| `rule/entity-drawer-whatsapp-not-call` | When the drawer shows a customer, put a "WhatsApp" action that opens whatsappHref(phone) in actions instead of a "Call" action on tel:, because customers are contacted by WhatsApp only and Call buttons were taken off every customer screen. | [entity-drawer](/system/entity-drawer.md) | app | review, plus `rg -n "tel:" app/(app)/customers components/credits` |
| `rule/filter-bar-chip-label` | When a chip stands for a field filter, label it {Field}: {value} in sentence case, and a search chip "{query}" in quotes, because the chip row is the only place a filter set inside the closed panel stays visible. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app | review |
| `rule/filter-bar-clear-all` | When chips can hold 2 or more chips, pass onClearAll too, because "Clear all" renders only when both are set and removing chips one by one takes one press each. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app | review |
| `rule/filter-bar-more-count` | When more is passed, pass moreActiveCount with the number of fields in it that differ from their default, because a closed panel otherwise hides that rows are being filtered out. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app, principle | review that `more=` and `moreActiveCount=` appear together |
| `rule/filter-bar-more-field` | When a control goes inside more, wrap it in MoreFilterField with a label, because the panel gives the control no other visible label and the two-column grid sizes each wrapper as one cell. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app, principle | review the `more` slot at each call site |
| `rule/filter-bar-no-hand-row` | When a list screen needs a search box beside filters, render FilterBar instead of a flex row with a raw <input type="search">, because the bar carries the sr-only label, the polite result line and the chip row that a hand-built row drops. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app | lint `rg -n 'type="search"' app components lib` outside `components/app/` |
| `rule/filter-bar-result-label` | When resultLabel is passed, write {count} {noun} with the singular noun for 1, and pass undefined while the list loads, because the line is announced on every change and a stale "0 sales" during a fetch is read as a result. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app, single use | review |
| `rule/filter-bar-search-label` | When search is passed, set search.label to "Search {records}" and the placeholder to the fields searched, because the placeholder disappears once someone types and the label is the field's only lasting name. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app, principle | review |
| `rule/filter-bar-trailing-actions` | When an action such as Export or a view toggle sits with the filters, pass it in trailing instead of filters, because trailing is pushed right with ml-auto and keeps actions apart from the controls that narrow the list. | [filter-bar](/system/filter-bar.md) | app, single use | review |
| `rule/filter-select-accessible-name` | When FilterSelect renders, give it ariaLabel or an id that a <label htmlFor> points at, because the trigger is a combobox whose text is only the current value, so with neither it is announced as "Fish, combobox" with no field name. | [filter-select](/system/filter-select.md) | app | review each `<FilterSelect` for `ariaLabel=` or `id=` |
| `rule/filter-select-all-option` | When a filter can be off, put a first option with a real value such as 'All' and map it to empty in onChange, because a value outside options shows the raw value, so '' renders an empty trigger with nothing checked and no way back to "no filter". | [filter-select](/system/filter-select.md) | app | review that `value` falls back to the first option's value |
| `rule/filter-select-compact-size` | When FilterSelect sits in a FilterBar filters slot or a toolbar row, pass size="compact" instead of writing h-9 w-auto min-w-40 data-[size=default]:h-9 in className, because the hand-written classes drift in width (min-w-32, min-w-36, min-w-40) and break when the primitive's data-[size] height changes. | [filter-select](/system/filter-select.md) | app, single use | review `className` on each `<FilterSelect` for `h-9` |
| `rule/filter-select-no-empty-fallback` | When a record's field can be missing, default value to a real option such as 'none' with the label "Choose a product" instead of ?? '', because '' matches no option and the field renders blank with no check. | [filter-select](/system/filter-select.md) | app | review `?? ''` inside `value=` on a `<FilterSelect` |
| `rule/filter-select-off-label` | When the first option turns a filter off, label it "All {plural noun}" for a set of things or "Any {noun}" for a state, in sentence case, because the closed trigger shows only that label and it must read as "no filter" at a glance. | [filter-select](/system/filter-select.md) | app | review the first option's label |
| `rule/inline-px` | A px, rem or em length for spacing, radius, size or font size in an inline style | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/named-color` | A CSS named color in a style, in any quote style | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/outside-name` | An outside product name from the config's names list in a shipped docs page. A warning, never a failure | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/overflow-menu-destructive-confirm` | When an item has destructive: true, its onSelect opens ConfirmDialog naming the record instead of acting at once, because the menu closes on select and nothing offers an undo. | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app | review |
| `rule/overflow-menu-hidden-flag` | When an item depends on a permission or the record's state, set hidden on it instead of building the array with conditions, because OverflowMenu then returns null when nothing is left and no empty ⋯ reaches the screen. | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app, single use | review |
| `rule/overflow-menu-item-sentence-case` | When writing an item label, use sentence case, such as "Export sales" or "Void sale", instead of Title Case, because the label is the item's only name and the app's labels are sentence case (app/globals.css:10). | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app | review |
| `rule/overflow-menu-no-hand-menu` | When a screen needs a ⋯ menu, render OverflowMenu instead of composing DropdownMenu or Base UI Menu with a MoreHorizontal trigger, because the hand-built one skips the hidden-item filter, the destructive group and the trigger sizes. | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app | lint `rg -n "MoreHorizontal" app components lib --glob '!components/app/overflow-menu.tsx'` prints nothing |
| `rule/overflow-menu-primary-outside` | When an action is the page's or record's main next step, render it as a Button beside the menu instead of as the menu's first item, because inside the menu it takes 2 presses and gives no visible cue. | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app | review |
| `rule/overflow-menu-record-label` | When the menu acts on one record, pass label as "Actions for {name}" or "More actions for {name}" instead of leaving the default "More actions", because in a table every trigger would otherwise share one accessible name. | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app | review |
| `rule/overflow-menu-size-by-place` | When the menu sits in a table row or a settings list, pass size="sm", and in a page header use the default size instead, because the trigger then matches the controls beside it: 32px RowAction in rows and 36px (h-9) buttons in headers. | [overflow-menu](/system/overflow-menu.md) | app | review |
| `rule/page-header-description-sentence` | When setting a fixed description, write 1 sentence in sentence case that ends with a full stop and says what the person does on the page, instead of a slogan or a list of features, because the line is the page's only explanation and sits at max-w-[65ch]. | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app | review |
| `rule/page-header-no-eyebrow` | When a page needs extra context, such as the location or the period, put it in description or the FilterBar under the header instead of an uppercase eyebrow, a breadcrumb or a badge above title, because labels in this app are sentence case with no uppercase micro labels (app/globals.css:10). | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app | review |
| `rule/page-header-one-per-route` | When a route under app/(app) renders its main content, render 1 PageHeader as the first child of the page wrapper instead of a hand-written <h1>, because PageHeader holds the page's only h1 and screen reader users jump to it by heading. | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app, principle | review |
| `rule/page-header-one-primary` | When actions is set, pass 1 primary action, placed last, and at most 1 secondary before it, and put every further action in overflow as an OverflowMenu instead, because the cluster is shrink-0 beside the title, so each extra button takes width from the title and description before anything wraps. | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app, single use | review |
| `rule/page-header-overflow-last` | When a page has secondary actions such as Import, Export, Template or Refresh, pass one OverflowMenu through overflow instead of a row of outline buttons, because the ⋯ trigger keeps the cluster to 2 or 3 controls and the restoration notes moved every such action there. | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app | review |
| `rule/page-header-tabs-slot` | When a page has page-level sections, pass its SectionTabs through tabs instead of rendering it after PageHeader or inside actions, because tabs keeps the section switch inside the same header as the h1, under the title row at every width. | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app | review |
| `rule/page-header-title-nav-label` | When setting title, use the route's label from components/layout/nav-config.ts, in sentence case, 1 or 2 words, instead of a phrase or a verb, because the h1 confirms the sidebar item the person pressed. | [page-header](/system/page-header.md) | app | review against `components/layout/nav-config.ts` |
| `rule/palette-use` | A Tailwind palette class such as text-gray-500, or var(--color-teal-700). Also bg-white, text-black and the other solid white or black utilities when the theme defines a role for that job: a surface (--background, --card, --popover) for bg, a foreground for text, fill and stroke, a border, input or ring for border, outline and ring. Opacity forms such as bg-black/50 and transparent pass | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/period-select-bounded-all` | When the screen's query cannot run unbounded, pass allowAll={false} instead of mapping "All time" to a hidden cap, because the label "All time" then promises rows the query never fetches. | [period-select](/system/period-select.md) | single use, principle | review queries that clamp `from` |
| `rule/period-select-filter-slot` | When a screen has a FilterBar, put PeriodSelect in its filters slot instead of beside the bar, because the bar wraps it with search and the other filters on phones. | [period-select](/system/period-select.md) | app | review |
| `rule/period-select-lagos-range` | When a query or a filter needs the period's bounds, compute them with periodRange or inPeriod from lib/period.ts instead of new Date() arithmetic, because every period is counted in Lagos days and a browser in another zone shifts the window by a day. | [period-select](/system/period-select.md) | single use, principle | review `new Date(` near period code |
| `rule/period-select-no-second-picker` | When a screen already has a PeriodSelect, keep one per screen instead of adding a second date picker for the same data, because two windows on one view make every KPI ambiguous. | [period-select](/system/period-select.md) | app | review |
| `rule/period-select-preset-labels` | When a period needs a name, take it from PERIOD_PRESETS or periodLabel ("Last 30 days", "This month", "1 Nov to 20 Nov") instead of writing new copy, because the same window must read the same on every screen. | [period-select](/system/period-select.md) | app, single use | review for period strings outside `lib/period.ts` |
| `rule/period-select-url-params` | When the screen's period belongs in the URL, write it with periodToParams and read it with parsePeriod using the same fallback, because the default preset is left out of the URL and a mismatched fallback turns a shared link into a different window. | [period-select](/system/period-select.md) | app | review the fallback argument on both calls |
| `rule/raw-value` | Hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() outside a token source line, including inside Tailwind arbitrary values | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/section-error-boundary-label` | When setting label, pass the section's name as a sentence-case noun phrase that reads before "couldn't load", such as "Customer list" or "Key figures", instead of leaving it out, because without it the title reads "This section couldn't load" and does not say which part failed. | [section-error-boundary](/system/section-error-boundary.md) | app | review |
| `rule/section-error-boundary-no-hand-boundary` | When a section needs an error fallback, wrap it in SectionErrorBoundary instead of writing another class with getDerivedStateFromError or a try and catch around JSX, because a second boundary drifts from this copy, this card and resetKey. | [section-error-boundary](/system/section-error-boundary.md) | app | lint `grep -rn "getDerivedStateFromError\\|componentDidCatch" app components lib` prints only `components/app/error-boundary.tsx` |
| `rule/section-error-boundary-no-raw-message` | When the fallback shows, keep its fixed copy instead of adding the caught error.message or a stack to the card, because the message is written for the person and the details go to the console under the label. | [section-error-boundary](/system/section-error-boundary.md) | single use, principle | review |
| `rule/section-error-boundary-per-section` | When a page shows sections that load on their own, such as KPIs, charts and lists, wrap each section in its own SectionErrorBoundary instead of one around the whole page, because one bad response then replaces only its own section. | [section-error-boundary](/system/section-error-boundary.md) | app, single use | review |
| `rule/section-error-boundary-reset-key` | When the boundary wraps content that changes with a tab, a page of results or a record, pass that value as resetKey instead of leaving it out or remounting with key, because without it the Failed card stays after the person moves to content that would render. | [section-error-boundary](/system/section-error-boundary.md) | app, single use | review |
| `rule/section-tabs-count-tone` | When a tab count stands for items that need action, set countTone to "warning" for pending or low and "danger" for overdue or out, and leave other counts "neutral", because status colour is reserved for real state. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | app, single use | review `countTone` values |
| `rule/section-tabs-hide-not-remove` | When a person may not see a section, pass the tab with hidden: true instead of filtering the array at the call site, because useSectionTab then treats a linked ?tab= for it as unknown and falls back to defaultTab. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | single use | review |
| `rule/section-tabs-label` | When rendering SectionTabs, set label to the name of the group, "{Page} sections" for a page header bar, because it names the tablist and the phone select, and a screen reader hears it before the first tab. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | app | review |
| `rule/section-tabs-local-controlled` | When tabs sit inside a card or drawer, or a tab change must also reset other URL params, pass value and onChange instead of defaultTab, because URL mode writes only its own param. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | app | review |
| `rule/section-tabs-nested-param` | When a URL-mode bar sits inside a section of another URL-mode bar, pass a distinct param such as "view", because both default to ?tab= and the inner bar would switch the page's section. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | single use | review pages with two `SectionTabs` tags |
| `rule/section-tabs-no-hand-tablist` | When a page needs sections under its title, render SectionTabs in the PageHeader tabs slot instead of a hand-built role="tablist" row, because the hand-built row misses the URL sync, the phone select and the count tones. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | app | lint `rg -n 'role="tablist"' app components lib` outside `components/app/` |
| `rule/section-tabs-same-default` | When a bar uses URL mode, read the active tab with useSectionTab passing the same defaultTab and param as the bar, because the bar and the panel otherwise disagree on which section is open when the URL has no tab. | [section-tabs](/system/section-tabs.md) | app | review both calls side by side |
| `rule/skeleton-not-raw-pulse` | When a screen needs a loading placeholder, render Skeleton instead of a hand-made div with animate-pulse bg-muted, because a raw copy misses the skeleton-shimmer hook and keeps pulsing under reduced motion. | [skeleton](/system/skeleton.md) | app | review, plus `rg -n "animate-pulse" app components lib --glob '!components/ui/**'` |
| `rule/skeleton-set-height` | When a Skeleton stands in for content, pass a height class in className, such as h-40 w-full for a 160px chart or h-4 w-24 for a line of text, instead of a bare <Skeleton />, because Skeleton is an empty div and draws 0px tall without one, so nothing shows and the content pushes the layout when it lands. | [skeleton](/system/skeleton.md) | app, principle | review |
| `rule/skeleton-shape-radius` | When a Skeleton stands for an avatar or a card, give it that element's radius, rounded-full for an avatar and rounded-xl for a card, instead of the default rounded-md, because the bar should outline what replaces it and the app's radius rule gives cards rounded-xl and avatars rounded-full. | [skeleton](/system/skeleton.md) | app | review |
| `rule/status-badge-domain-first` | When the status is a payment, stock or work word listed in STATUS_TONES, pass domain and status instead of tone with a local mapping, because the shared table keeps one tone per word on every screen. | [status-badge](/system/status-badge.md) | app | review |
| `rule/status-badge-label-case` | When writing the label, use 1 to 3 words in sentence case, such as "In stock", "Part paid" or "Expires in 3 days", instead of capitals or Title Case, because the visual rules set every label in sentence case and the badge is read in a table scan. | [status-badge](/system/status-badge.md) | app | review |

## What the check can't see

A reviewer or a browser covers these. Passing `node scripts/check.mjs` says nothing about them.

- Rendered contrast, including non-text contrast of borders, focus rings and checkbox edges. Measure it in a browser.
- Behavior: what a click, Enter or Escape does, focus order and focus return, and whether Cancel submits.
- Layout at each viewport, overflow at 390px and touch target sizes.
- Visual overrides on components the registry does not list, and overrides built at runtime: cn() branches, spread props, a class name held in a variable.
- A loading state shown some other way than a label ternary on the button, such as a label read from a variable.
- Class names and values built at runtime, such as template strings, cn() branches or fontSize: size / 2.5.
- bg-white and text-black when the theme defines no role for their job, their opacity forms such as bg-black/50, and CSS keywords such as white in var() fallbacks.
- Files outside the include folders, and ui files missing from the drift list (they are scanned, but no hash guards them).
- Whether a token's role comment still matches how the token is used.
- Rules the generated rules page marks review, or enforces only through their own Check: clause.
- Motion that is only measured: exit slower than enter, frequent-surface motion, linear easing, press delay, input lag and jank. Easing set in script or through a variable, and hover reveals written as Tailwind classes (v4 guards hover: itself, v3 does not).
- Whether a pressed style covers the control whose tap highlight was removed: any pressed style in the repo passes trap/touch-tap-highlight.
